scope: At a 52-hour native cutoff, observe an aircraft waiting for a physical LRU, a stocked depot LRU and a failed base LRU simultaneously in opposite-direction transit. Keep the catalog's reservation dimension unverified unless separate native evidence establishes it.

source.boundary: The 49.5-hour unchanged-route probe was rejected by native converter #204 because the last mission may return after the period. This candidate extends the period beyond that scheduled mission and slows only the two-way base/depot route so the physical shipments remain active. It cannot serve as a pure cutoff comparison to the accepted 2-hour route.

pre_run_hypotheses: The complete authored delta is Control.SIMPE/RCEND 60→52, both ResultCollection.RCEND 60→52, and StationStructure.TFRMS/TTOMS 2→5. All other cells and source data remain exact. Check all populated tables after native import/export.

Guarded session-0 SSH import, export, calc and JSON report should complete with the global mutex and GUI PID 13340 preserved. Require zero converter errors and only reviewed warning #108; reject any invalid or empty output.

Observe the child critical fault, aircraft SURP task, base LRU demand/backorder, physical depot LRU issue and depot→base transport, failed base LRU removal and base→depot transport directly. The changed route may alter event timing; do not assume the accepted parent trace is an identical prefix.

At 52 hours, require both named physical LRUs to have departed and neither to have arrived, the aircraft SURP still unfinished and a base LRU backorder outstanding. Distinguish an in-repair aircraft from an item physically undergoing depot repair: the latter should not yet have arrived at the depot.

Reconcile 104 half-hour SystemResults, StockTotalResults and ResourceResults bins with event-derived intervals, including mission completion/cancellation, PM and resource status. Reconcile stock debit, base demand, backorder integral and both in-transit identities; do not infer a final instant balance solely from a half-hour average.

Accept only directly observed terminal states with sealed raw files, exact source/diff, author replay and separate independent read-only replay. If conversion or target event evidence fails, retain this version as an excluded diagnostic and revise under a fresh version.
limits: One seed, two aircraft, one base/depot route, one 52-hour cutoff and five-hour two-way transport. No item-reservation claim.
The case does not establish a universal horizon rule, post-cutoff completion, other transit distributions, larger fleets, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine equivalence.

revised_from.reason: 49.5-hour unchanged-route cutoff produces native error #204 and a four-byte invalid SXO.
